name: Hydrogen
fact: The most common thing in the whole universe! Also lives inside water (H₂O).

name: Helium
fact: Lifts balloons and makes your voice squeaky!

name: Lithium
fact: Inside phone batteries! Very bouncy element.

name: Beryllium
fact: Very light and strong — used in rockets!

name: Boron
fact: Makes slime bouncy! Also in laundry soap.

name: Carbon
fact: Makes DIAMONDS! Also pencils and all living things.

name: Nitrogen
fact: 78% of the air you breathe is nitrogen!

name: Oxygen
fact: The stuff you breathe in! Super important for life.

name: Fluorine
fact: It's in toothpaste — keeps your teeth strong!

name: Neon
fact: Makes the bright glowy signs in shops!

name: Sodium
fact: Half of table salt! (NaCl)

name: Magnesium
fact: Burns with a super bright white flame!

name: Aluminum
fact: Cola cans! Foil! Super light metal.

name: Silicon
fact: Inside every computer chip! That's why Silicon Valley!

name: Phosphorus
fact: Makes matches catch fire!

name: Sulfur
fact: Yellow, smells like rotten eggs!

name: Chlorine
fact: The other half of salt — and cleans swimming pools!

name: Argon
fact: A super lazy gas — doesn't react with anything!

name: Iron
fact: Makes magnets! Also inside your blood (makes it red).

name: Copper
fact: Orange shiny metal in every electric wire!

name: Silver
fact: Shiny like a mirror! Used in jewellery and medals.

name: Gold
fact: Treasure! Also in computer chips — never rusts!
